mapper.sql: r.reply_id, r.comment_id, r.from_user_id, r.to_user_id, r.reply_msg, r.reply_time, r.r_star
mapper.select: SELECT , fu.nickname as from_user_nick, tu.nickname as to_user_nick FROM a_reply r LEFT JOIN user fu ON r.from_user_id = fu.user_id LEFT JOIN user tu ON r.to_user_id = tu.user_id WHERE r.reply_id = #{replyId} LIMIT 1

SELECT , fu.nickname as from_user_nick, tu.nickname as to_user_nick FROM a_reply r LEFT JOIN user fu ON r.from_user_id = fu.user_id LEFT JOIN user tu ON r.to_user_id = tu.user_id WHERE r.comment_id = #{commentId} ORDER BY r.reply_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO a_reply (comment_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, reply_msg, r_star) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{replyMsg}, #{replyStar})
mapper.update: UPDATE a_reply SET r_star = r_star + 1 WHERE reply_id = #{replyId}
UPDATE a_reply SET r_star = GREATEST(r_star - 1, 0) WHERE reply_id = #{replyId}
